# Test cases of the hex package, kept as data.
#
# One case per line: OPERATION|INPUT|EXPECTED. OPERATION is the command line
# of tests/driver.bmb (words separated by spaces), INPUT is what it reads on
# standard input and EXPECTED is what it must write on standard output. INPUT
# and EXPECTED are written with the escapes of printf %b (\xHH for a byte,
# \\ for a backslash, \x7c for |). Lines that start with # are comments.

# ---- From the original crate, src/lib.rs `mod test` ----

# test_encode_to_slice
encode_to_slice 8|kiwi|6b697769
encode_to_slice 10|kiwis|6b69776973
encode_to_slice 100|kiwis|Err(InvalidStringLength)

# test_decode_to_slice
decode_to_slice 4|6b697769|kiwi
decode_to_slice 5|6b69776973|kiwis
decode_to_slice 4|6|Err(OddLength)

# test_encode
encode|foobar|666f6f626172

# test_decode
decode|666f6f626172|foobar

# test_from_hex_okay_str and test_from_hex_okay_bytes (a str and a byte
# string are the same input here)
decode|666f6f626172|foobar
decode|666F6F626172|foobar

# test_invalid_length
decode|1|Err(OddLength)
decode|666f6f6261721|Err(OddLength)

# test_invalid_char
decode|66ag|Err(InvalidHexCharacter { c: 'g', index: 3 })

# test_empty
decode||

# test_from_hex_whitespace
decode|666f 6f62617|Err(InvalidHexCharacter { c: ' ', index: 4 })

# test_from_hex_array: <[u8; 6]>::from_hex and <[u8; 5]>::from_hex, which are
# decode_to_slice into an array of that length
decode_to_slice 6|666f6f626172|\x66\x6f\x6f\x62\x61\x72
decode_to_slice 5|666f6f626172|Err(InvalidStringLength)

# test_to_hex: encode_hex::<String> and encode_hex_upper::<String>
encode|\x66\x6f\x6f\x62\x61\x72|666f6f626172
encode_upper|\x66\x6f\x6f\x62\x61\x72|666F6F626172

# ---- From the original crate, src/error.rs `mod tests` (test_display) ----

# FromHexError::InvalidHexCharacter { c: '\n', index: 5 }.to_string(): the
# first non-digit of this input is '\n' at position 5
decode display|00000\n|Invalid character '\\n' at position 5
# FromHexError::OddLength.to_string()
decode display|1|Odd number of digits
# FromHexError::InvalidStringLength.to_string()
decode_to_slice 5 display|666f6f626172|Invalid string length

# ---- From the original crate, the examples in the documentation ----

encode|Hello world!|48656c6c6f20776f726c6421
encode|\x01\x02\x03\x0f\x10|0102030f10
encode_upper|Hello world!|48656C6C6F20776F726C6421
encode_upper|\x01\x02\x03\x0f\x10|0102030F10
decode|48656c6c6f20776f726c6421|Hello world!
decode|123|Err(OddLength)
# The documentation only says this is an error; it is OddLength.
decode|foo|Err(OddLength)
decode_to_slice 4|6b697769|kiwi
encode_to_slice 8|kiwi|6b697769
# <[u8; 12]>::from_hex
decode_to_slice 12|48656c6c6f20776f726c6421|Hello world!
# "Hello world!".encode_hex::<String>()
encode|Hello world!|48656c6c6f20776f726c6421

# ---- RFC 4648 §10, the BASE16 test vectors ----

encode_upper||
encode_upper|f|66
encode_upper|fo|666F
encode_upper|foo|666F6F
encode_upper|foob|666F6F62
encode_upper|fooba|666F6F6261
encode_upper|foobar|666F6F626172
decode||
decode|66|f
decode|666F|fo
decode|666F6F|foo
decode|666F6F62|foob
decode|666F6F6261|fooba
decode|666F6F626172|foobar
